outcome: Implementation can no longer begin before its contract exists and survived an independent grill: the decomposition recorder refuses execution detail on future tasks, a shared readiness gate makes stage start and delegate refuse incomplete or ungrilled frontier contracts (and the silent empty-scope read-only downgrade is gone), and forge next walks the dev through the JIT loop one action at a time - enter plan mode and author, grill, start, delegate. The docs now say what the gates enforce. A dev following the rail cannot skip contract authoring or grilling by accident.
